name: @continuallabs/agent-logger-mcp

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot from the browser. Requires the Chrome extension to be active on a tab.

mode.description: Capture mode: viewport (visible area), full (entire page), element (specific element), region (selected area)

tabId.description: Optional tab ID to get screenshot for a specific tab

tools.name: browser_get_screenshot
tools.description: Get the last captured screenshot from the browser

tabId.description: Optional tab ID to get screenshot for a specific tab

tools.name: browser_get_element
tools.description: Get information about the currently selected element in the browser. Use the extension's 'Select Element' feature first.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID to get element for a specific tab

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click on an element in the browser by CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an input element in the browser

selector.description: CSS selector of the input element

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element in the browser

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to hover

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll to an element in the browser

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to scroll to

position.description: Where to position the element in viewport

tools.name: browser_get_errors
tools.description: Get browser console errors captured by the extension

limit.description: Maximum number of errors to return

format.description: Output format: 'compact' for token efficiency, 'detailed' for full info

filter.description: Filter out noise (analytics, tracking) - set false to see all

tools.name: browser_get_error
tools.description: Get full details of a specific error by index (from browser_get_errors output)

tools.name: browser_get_page_info
tools.description: Get information about the browser connection status

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Check the connection status of the browser extension and retrieve any queued browser events

tools.name: browser_auto_push
tools.description: Toggle or check auto-push mode. When enabled, browser events (screenshots, element selections, errors) are queued and shown when you call browser_status or browser_get_events.

enable.description: Set to true to enable, false to disable. Omit to just check current status.

tools.name: browser_get_events
tools.description: Get any queued browser events (screenshots, element selections, errors). Call this to see what the browser extension has sent.

tools.name: browser_get_accessibility
tools.description: Get accessibility information for an element - ARIA roles, labels, states, focusability, and a11y issues

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to inspect

tools.name: browser_check_a11y
tools.description: Check a page or element for accessibility issues

selector.description: CSS selector to check (defaults to entire page)
